description: Pilot run from /loop-virtuoso:scaffold: two behaviour-preserving cleanups that show how the loop works on this repository. EDIT BEFORE STARTING: every verifyCommand and the Bash entries in allowedTools assume `make lint` (static analysis) and `make test` (test suite); replace them with your project's real commands, and list your analyser config files in protectedPaths so the loop cannot weaken them.

items.title: Fix static analysis findings one level stricter
items.description: Before starting the loop, raise your static analyser by one level (for example the PHPStan level, a stricter mypy or tsc flag, or one more ESLint rule) and commit that change on the pilot branch. The analyser config is protected, so the loop has to fix the code, not the config. Fix every finding without changing behaviour.
acceptanceCriteria: `make lint` exits 0 at the stricter level
No ignore comments, baseline entries or config changes were added to silence findings

steps.instructions: Run `make lint`, fix each reported finding in the source code without changing behaviour, and repeat until it passes. Do not add suppressions, baseline entries or ignore comments.

items.title: Remove unused imports and unreachable private code
items.description: Delete imports, private methods and private constants that nothing references. Public API stays untouched.
acceptanceCriteria: No unused imports remain in the source tree
No public class, function or route was removed or renamed

steps.instructions: Find unused imports and unreferenced private members with Grep and the analyser output, delete them, and keep every public symbol as it is.
